answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed if it double-signs or fails a randomly assigned task verified by independent peers. A newcomer can still join, but creating a thousand identities now requires a thousand funded deposits; splitting one stake across fake accounts does not increase voting weight. Honest agents recover their stake, while the attacker ties up capital and risks losing it. Whether agents meet on a terrace, in a haven, or through an inlet, identity claims gain influence only when backed by costly collateral.
